description: Fetch a paper's full metadata: title, authors, year, abstract, TLDR (LLM-generated), key findings, citation count, GitHub repos, HuggingFace models/datasets, videos, peer reviews, and links. Accepts an arXiv ID (e.g. '2401.12345' or '1706.03762v5') or an OpenAlex Work ID (e.g. 'W4390723197'). Use when the user names a specific paper or pastes an arXiv link.

id.description: arXiv ID like '2401.12345' or OpenAlex Work ID like 'W4390723197'.

name: get_paper
